def redpos(a): return sorted([(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='R' and c<32])

    return [(r,c,pa[r][c],a[r][c]) for r in range(62) for c in range(64) if pa[r][c]!=a[r][c]]
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

# Re-click redT (now no outline) - does red move again?

action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
